story.logline: Take the promise of Rehearsal Performer literally and build a physical world where it is simply true.
story.dramaticQuestion: Does Rehearsal Performer still hold once the rule of the world changes?

beats.title: Hook
beats.purpose: Interrupt with the strangest true image of the idea
beats.emotionalTurn: the confident wonder is established before anything is explained

beats.title: Friction
beats.purpose: Show the world straining without the promise
beats.emotionalTurn: the confident wonder tightens as the want becomes specific

beats.title: The Turn
beats.purpose: The subject enters and the rule of the world changes
beats.emotionalTurn: the confident wonder turns costly and the easy option closes

beats.title: Proof
beats.purpose: Hero behaviour rendered as physical fact, close enough to touch
beats.emotionalTurn: the confident wonder breaks into a decision that cannot be taken back

beats.title: Button
beats.purpose: One held image that owns the promise, with any title reserved for post
beats.emotionalTurn: the confident wonder settles into what the decision left behind

shots.title: Hook
shots.intent: Interrupt with the strangest true image of the idea
shots.subject: June with performer in frame
shots.action: interrupt with the strangest true image of the idea, staged so the change is visible in frame
shots.environment: marked mat in an empty practice, dressed plainly so performer reads first

camera.movement: locked tripod with a slow settle
camera.framing: subject on the lower third with the world readable above
camera.focusBehavior: deep focus holds both subject and environment legible

lighting.motivation: the only powered source in marked mat in an empty practice

physics: performer holds its mass and does not drift between beats
contact between hand and object deforms both believably
any settling motion decays under gravity rather than stopping abruptly

beats.action: the frame settles and performer is established in its opening state
the beat resolves into a stable handoff

continuityLocks: light direction and screen direction unchanged
imperfectionAnchors: dust settled along a single seam
an uneven patina where the object is handled most
one edge worn lighter than the rest

soundDesignDirectives: low room tone with no music bed
fabric movement bound to visible motion

exclusions: no invented signage, logos, or on-screen text
